query_dsl.description: The search query in OpenSearch query DSL format. For keyword-type fields (mapping shows "type": "keyword"), use field name DIRECTLY - do NOT add .keyword suffix. For text-type fields with .keyword subfields, use the .keyword suffix for exact matches. For date/time range queries, MUST include "format" parameter (commonly "format": "strict_date_optional_time||epoch_millis"), e.g. {"range": {"timestamp": {"gte": "2025-12-29T17:15:12Z", "lte": "2025-12-30T08:15:12Z", "format": "strict_date_optional_time||epoch_millis"}}}; if using non-ISO formats, adjust "format" accordingly.
